newsitem.title: USA: Montana rains cause flooding, also bring relief.
newsitem.headline: Montana rains cause flooding, also bring relief.

text.p: Some areas of Montana reported flooding of fields during the week ended Sunday, while in drier areas the precipitation was welcomed, the state's Agricultural Statistics Service reported.
"Crop conditions did not change much from a week ago and remain mostly good to excellent," the report said.
Spring wheat in boot was 29 pct vs seven a week ago, 19 a year ago and 39 on average. Four percent of the spring wheat crop was headed, versus the five-year average of 10 percent.
Spring wheat was rated 51 percent good to excellent vs 54 percent good to excellent last week and 36 percent fair vs 35 last week.
Barley in boot 33 pct vs eight w/a, 19 y/a, 42 avg.
Barley was rated 67 percent good to excellent vs 69 percent good to excellent last week, 28 percent fair vs 27 pct last week.
Winter wheat rated 66 percent good to excellent versus 64 percent good to excellent last week, 27 percent fair vs 26 pct last week.
Oats emerged 97 pct vs 95 w/a, 98 y/a, 99 avg.
Oats rated 49 percent good to excellent vs 46 percent good to excellent last week, 33 percent fair vs 39 pct fair last week.
